family: The single total certificate-prefix language defined by the fixed evaluator in proof.md. At actual length N<2^20 output 0. Otherwise let b be the least positive integer with b^5>=N^3, let ell be the least prime strictly greater than b, put r=floor(N/ell)-1 and t=ceil(sqrt(r)). Read the first ell input bits as the coefficients below the leading term of a monic degree-ell polynomial P over F_2; output 0 unless X^(2^ell)=X mod P and gcd(P,X^2-X)=1. For a valid prefix read the next r*ell bits as x_1,...,x_r in K=F_2[X]/(P), in the polynomial basis with constant coefficient first; set y_i=x_i^(2^(r+2-i)-1) and output the absolute trace of the order-t elementary symmetric polynomial in y_1,...,y_r. Ignore the final N-(r+1)*ell bits. All prefix, payload and ignored bits count in N. One fixed polynomial-time evaluator and the empty-witness verifier define every length.
theorem: This fixed total language is in P, hence in NP with the empty witness. In the pinned full B2 model, for every integer N>=2^25, C_B2(F_N)>=4N-13N^(4/5). Thus the eventual_lower_bound with leading term 4N and explicit remainder 13N^(4/5) holds for one fixed family, and liminf over all integer N of C_B2(F_N)/N is at least 4. The same evaluator and verifier apply at every integer length, including the small lengths on which the evaluator outputs zero.
